verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a hosted AI app builder, but the evidence pack has no setting or documented option to disable Floot's own telemetry or usage tracking. The built-in visitor tracking feature collects analytics for apps users build, which is adjacent, and exporting code to self-host is a user-side workaround, not a documented opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
